name: run_command
description: Runs one local shell command with POSIX sh and returns its exit code, stdout, stderr, and whether it timed out.
when_to_use: Use this when you need to run one non-interactive shell command on the user's machine (build, test, git, ls, grep and so on) and see the exit code and output, optionally in a specific working directory or with a time limit.
limitations: The command cannot be interactive because stdin is empty. No TTY is attached, so some tools change their output. Output is decoded as UTF-8, with invalid bytes replaced. On timeout, the whole process group is killed and exit_code is null. Any partial output that was collected is still returned. The command uses the user's environment and has no sandbox.

exit_code.description: Process exit code; null if timed out
